"""Rules and pricing with synthetic data only (never values of a real scenario)."""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal as D

from rfq.rules.parse import cert, number, when
from rfq.rules.resolve import Context, build, largest_remainder, marginal_bonus

T = datetime(2030, 3, 10, 9, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
REF = "XT-2030-0001"


def test_numbers_with_locales():
    assert number("4.321,09 (de-DE)") == D("4321.09")
    assert number("512,345 (en-US)") == D("512345")
    assert number("12,345.67 (en-US)") == D("12345.67")
    assert number("7.85") == D("7.85")
    assert number("1,00") == D("1.00")
    assert number("1.234.567") == D("1234567")
    assert number("5 %") == D("5")
    assert number(None) is None


def test_dates_and_certificates():
    assert when("2030-03-10T08:00:00Z") == datetime(2030, 3, 10, 8, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    assert when("10.03.2030, 09:00").day == 10
    assert cert("keine gefordert") == cert(None) == cert("Ohne Zertifizierung") == ""
    assert cert("EN 1234") == "EN1234"


def test_largest_remainder_ties_by_position():
    shares = largest_remainder(D("0.10"), {"02": D(1), "01": D(1), "03": D(1)})
    assert shares == {"01": D("0.04"), "02": D("0.03"), "03": D("0.03")}
    assert sum(shares.values()) == D("0.10")


def test_marginal_bonus_bands():
    bands = [{"from_eur": "0", "to_eur": "100", "rate_percent": "0"},
             {"from_eur": "100", "to_eur": "200", "rate_percent": "10"},
             {"from_eur": "200", "to_eur": None, "rate_percent": "20"}]
    assert marginal_bonus(D("250"), bands) == D("20.00")
    assert marginal_bonus(D("100"), bands) == D("0.00")


def _evidence(**overrides):
    mail = lambda topic, data, sender, at="2030-03-09T10:00:00Z", ref=REF: {"data": {
        "subject": f"{topic} {ref}", "sender": sender, "datetime_utc": at, "reference": ref,
        "is_draft_or_preview": False, "topic": topic, "data": data}}
    bb = {
        "positions": [{"data": {"positions": [
            {"position": "1.1", "quantity": "8", "unit": "Stk", "requirement_ref": "R-A"},
            {"position": "1.2", "quantity": "2", "unit": "Satz", "requirement_ref": "R-B"}]}}],
        "clarifications": [{"data": {"entries": [
            {"number": "11", "datetime_utc": "2030-03-01T10:00:00Z", "facts": [{"type": "quantity_change", "position": "1.1", "quantity": "9", "unit": "Stk"}]},
            {"number": "5", "datetime_utc": "2030-03-02T10:00:00Z", "facts": [{"type": "quantity_change", "position": "1.1", "quantity": "10", "unit": "Stk"}]},
            {"number": "12", "datetime_utc": "2030-03-03T10:00:00Z", "facts": [{"type": "quantity_change", "position": "1.1", "quantity": "99", "unit": "Stk"}]},
            {"number": "13", "datetime_utc": "2030-03-04T10:00:00Z", "facts": [{"type": "withdrawal", "withdrawn_number": "12"}]},
            {"number": "14", "datetime_utc": "2030-03-04T10:00:00Z", "facts": [
                {"type": "condition_group", "position": "1.1", "group": "G-1"},
                {"type": "setup_cost", "position": "1.1", "amount_eur": "25.00"},
                {"type": "assignment", "position": "1.1", "packaging_key": "P-1", "delivery_key": None, "setup_pool_key": None, "bonus_plan_key": None}]},
        ]}}],
        "spec_revisions": [{"data": {"revisions": [{"revision": "V1", "status_text": "ersetzt", "is_current": False},
                                                   {"revision": "V2", "status_text": "gültig", "is_current": True}]}}],
        "requirements": [
            {"data": {"revision": "V1", "requirements": [{"ref": "R-A", "bore_mm": "1", "stroke_mm": "1", "pressure_bar": "1", "mounting": "X"}]}},
            {"data": {"revision": "V2", "requirements": [
                {"ref": "R-A", "bore_mm": "40", "stroke_mm": "100", "pressure_bar": "200", "mounting": "Flansch", "certification": None, "catalog_group": "G1"},
                {"ref": "R-B", "bore_mm": "50", "stroke_mm": "200", "pressure_bar": "200", "mounting": "Flansch", "certification": None, "catalog_group": "G2", "pieces_per_set": 3}]}}],
        "materials": [{"data": {"materials": [
            {"material_number": "M-1", "catalog_group": "G1", "bore_mm": "40", "stroke_mm": "100", "pressure_bar": "200", "mounting": "Flansch",
             "certification": "none", "status_meaning": "active", "pieces_per_carton": "4", "surcharge_mass_g": "500", "price_index_key": "IX",
             "lead_time_stock_weeks": "2", "lead_time_production_weeks": "8", "unrestricted_stock": "50",
             "conditions": [{"valid_from": "2030-01-01", "valid_to": "2030-12-31", "currency": "EUR", "price_unit_qty": "1", "number_format": "de-DE",
                             "scales": [{"from_qty": "1", "price": "120,00"}, {"from_qty": "10", "price": "100,00"}]}]},
            {"material_number": "M-0", "catalog_group": "G1", "bore_mm": "40", "stroke_mm": "100", "pressure_bar": "200", "mounting": "Flansch",
             "certification": "none", "status_meaning": "blocked"},
            {"material_number": "M-2", "catalog_group": "G2", "bore_mm": "50", "stroke_mm": "200", "pressure_bar": "200", "mounting": "Flansch",
             "certification": None, "status_meaning": "active", "pieces_per_carton": "10", "lead_time_stock_weeks": "1",
             "lead_time_production_weeks": "9", "unrestricted_stock": "1",
             "conditions": [{"valid_from": "2030-01-01", "valid_to": "2030-12-31", "currency": "USD", "fx_key": "F-1", "price_unit_qty": "100",
                             "number_format": "en-US", "scales": [{"from_qty": "1", "price": "10,000"}]}]}]}}],
        "mail_list": [{"data": {"mailbox_address": "sales@bidder.example"}}],
        "mail_message": [
            mail("discount", {"is_approval": True, "percent": "10", "min_order_value_eur": "1.00"}, "boss@bidder.example"),
            mail("discount", {"is_approval": True, "percent": "50"}, "boss@bidder.example", ref=REF + "-A"),
            mail("discount", {"is_approval": True, "percent": "60"}, "boss@other.example"),
            mail("discount", {"is_approval": True, "percent": "70"}, "boss@bidder.example", at="2030-03-11T10:00:00Z"),
            mail("clause_rules", {"groups": {"G-1": "base_and_surcharge"}}, "calc@bidder.example"),
            mail("packaging", {"tariffs": {"P-1": {"eur_per_carton": "3.00"}}}, "log@bidder.example"),
            mail("fx", {"rates": {"F-1": {"currency": "USD", "eur_per_unit": "0.5"}}}, "fin@bidder.example"),
            mail("metal_index", {"indices": {"IX": [{"eur_per_kg": "9.00", "valid_from": "2030-01-01", "valid_to": "2030-03-09"},
                                                    {"eur_per_kg": "2.00", "valid_from": "2030-03-10", "valid_to": "2030-04-30"}]}}, "calc@bidder.example"),
        ],
    }
    bb.update(overrides)
    return bb


CTX = Context(tender_reference=REF, scenario=T, director_localpart="boss",
              authorized={"clause_rules": "calc", "packaging": "log", "fx": "fin", "metal_index": "calc"})


def test_full_bid():
    result = build(CTX, _evidence())
    answer = result.answer
    assert answer["decision"] == "bid" and answer["discount_percent"] == 10.0
    p1, p2 = answer["positions"]
    # 1.1: q=10 (withdrawn 99 ignored), M-1 active (M-0 blocked), scale 10 -> 100.00, index window 2.00 -> mass 1.00,
    # scope base+surcharge, setup 25.00, packaging ceil(10/4)=3 cartons * 3.00 = 9.00
    assert (p1["material_number"], p1["quantity"], p1["base_unit_price"]) == ("M-1", 10, 100.0)
    assert p1["surcharge_per_unit"] == 3.5 and p1["packaging_per_unit"] == 0.9
    assert p1["unit_price"] == 94.3        # 90 + 0.9 + (25 + 9)/10 = 94.30
    assert p1["lead_time_weeks"] == 2
    # 1.2: 2 Satz x 3 = 6 pieces, USD 10000 per 100 -> 100 USD * 0.5 = 50.00 EUR, discount on base only
    assert (p2["material_number"], p2["quantity"], p2["base_unit_price"], p2["unit_price"]) == ("M-2", 6, 50.0, 45.0)
    assert p2["lead_time_weeks"] == 9      # stock 1 < 6
    assert answer["total_net"] == round(10 * 94.3 + 6 * 45.0, 2)


def test_conditional_discount_fails_below_threshold():
    bb = _evidence()
    bb["mail_message"][0]["data"]["data"]["min_order_value_eur"] = "999999"
    assert build(CTX, bb).answer["discount_percent"] == 0.0

    assert not revision_is_current({"status_text": "invalid"})

    assert revision_is_current({"status_text": None, "is_current": True})
    assert not revision_is_current({"status_text": None})


def test_negative_status_is_not_chosen_as_current():
    bb = _evidence()
    bb["spec_revisions"] = [{"data": {"revisions": [{"revision": "V1", "status_text": "ungültig"},
                                                    {"revision": "V2", "status_text": "gültig"}]}}]
    result = build(CTX, bb)

    result = build(CTX, bb)                                                      # no group proven searched
    assert result.answer["decision"] == "bid"
    assert "1.1" in result.skipped
    assert any("not proven complete" in line for line in result.trace)


def test_unknown_status_stays_uncertain():

    for m in bb["materials"][0]["data"]["materials"]:
        m["status_meaning"] = None
    result = build(CTX, bb)
    assert result.answer["decision"] == "bid"
    assert any("UNCERTAIN" in line for line in result.trace)


def test_proven_complete_blocked_search_gives_no_bid():
    bb = _evidence()
    bb["materials"][0]["data"]["materials"][0]["status_meaning"] = "blocked"
    ctx = Context(**{**CTX.__dict__, "searched_groups": {"G1"}})

"""B08 + B02: deadlines hold through slots, hung calls and retries; ended missions wake the ERP phase."""
import asyncio
import time

import pytest

from rfq import llm
from rfq.agent import orchestrator as orch_mod
from rfq.agent.orchestrator import Orchestrator


class _HangingCompletions:
    async def create(self, **kwargs):
        await asyncio.sleep(kwargs.get("timeout", 60))      # behaves like a request that never answers in time
        raise TimeoutError("hung")


class _HangingClient:
    chat = type("C", (), {"completions": _HangingCompletions()})()


def test_hung_model_call_respects_the_deadline(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(llm, "client", lambda: _HangingClient())
    started = time.time()
    with pytest.raises(llm.DeadlineExceeded):
        asyncio.run(llm.chat([{"role": "user", "content": "x"}], deadline=time.time() + 6))
    assert time.time() - started < 9


def test_busy_slots_respect_the_deadline(monkeypatch):
    async def scenario():
        slots = asyncio.Semaphore(1)
        monkeypatch.setattr(llm, "_slots", slots)
        await slots.acquire()                                  # another call holds the only slot
        await llm.chat([{"role": "user", "content": "x"}], deadline=time.time() + 4)
    started = time.time()
    with pytest.raises(llm.DeadlineExceeded):
        asyncio.run(scenario())
    assert time.time() - started < 6

"""B08 + B02: deadlines hold through slots, hung calls and retries; ended missions wake the ERP phase."""
import asyncio
import time

import pytest

from rfq import llm
from rfq.agent import orchestrator as orch_mod
from rfq.agent.orchestrator import Orchestrator


class _HangingCompletions:
    async def create(self, **kwargs):
        await asyncio.sleep(kwargs.get("timeout", 60))      # behaves like a request that never answers in time
        raise TimeoutError("hung")


class _HangingClient:
    chat = type("C", (), {"completions": _HangingCompletions()})()


def test_hung_model_call_respects_the_deadline(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(llm, "client", lambda: _HangingClient())
    started = time.time()
    with pytest.raises(llm.DeadlineExceeded):
        asyncio.run(llm.chat([{"role": "user", "content": "x"}], deadline=time.time() + 6))
    assert time.time() - started < 9


def test_busy_slots_respect_the_deadline(monkeypatch):
    async def scenario():
        slots = asyncio.Semaphore(1)
        monkeypatch.setattr(llm, "_slots", slots)
        await slots.acquire()                                  # another call holds the only slot
        await llm.chat([{"role": "user", "content": "x"}], deadline=time.time() + 4)
    started = time.time()
    with pytest.raises(llm.DeadlineExceeded):
        asyncio.run(scenario())
    assert time.time() - started < 6

usage: python dev/eval/score.py <answer.json> [--oracle dev/oracle/public-1.json]
Implements the bid-case table from docs/01-challenge.md. The two "checks" are approximations: the withdrawn-Q&A check
is scored as "the position whose quantity the oracle marks as withdrawn-affected is right", the metal-index check as
"every position's surcharge_per_unit is right". Sandbox test runs remain the ground truth.
"""
import argparse, json
from decimal import Decimal as D
from pathlib import Path

FIELDS = {"material_number": .20, "quantity": .15, "base_unit_price": .15, "surcharge_per_unit": .10,
          "packaging_per_unit": .10, "rebate_total": .10, "unit_price": .10, "lead_time_weeks": .10}
WITHDRAWN_CHECK_POSITION = "01.05"   # public-1 only (dev); the private set has its own

def eq(a, b) -> bool:
    if a is None or b is None:

# Answers and scoring

> In this document, `$API` is https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai (the CLI and API guide call it `$ATIRA_API`).

Each challenge defines its answer format and how quality is scored; the platform measures cost and time and
ranks everyone the same way. Test runs, scored submissions and the scouting logins use the public dataset (the
websites as you see them, with scenario `public-1`), and the leaderboard ranks those results. The correct answer
isn't published; your system has to work it out from the websites. When the hackathon ends, a [final run](#final-run)
on a private dataset weighs most when we pick the [winners](#winners).

## Per run

- **Quality** (0 to 100): how right the answer is, by the challenge's scorer.
- **Eligible:** whether the answer meets the challenge's mandatory criteria. For RFQ: the right tender reference;
  a wrong decision (bid or no_bid) costs quality points instead.
- **Cost:** the run's LLM usage, priced per model, in USD.
- **Time:** from the start of your run command to your accepted answer.

A malformed answer is rejected with a `400` and does not end the run. A well-formed answer is final, even if it
is wrong. A run without an answer scores quality 0 and is not eligible.

## Leaderboard

Each scored submission runs once in the sandbox on the public dataset and is scored; one run per submission
keeps your model bill down. A submission appears once its run has finished and review is passed; reviewer flags await organizer approval. Each team is ranked by its best
complete submission. The API reports them in its `median_*` fields; with one run per submission, that is
the run's own value.

1. Eligible before ineligible.
2. Higher quality.
3. Lower cost × time: the submission's cost in USD times its time, with cost counted as at least $0.01 and time
   as at least 1 second. Cost and time weigh the same: halving your model bill counts as much as halving your run
   time, and among free runs the faster one wins.
4. The submission ID, when everything above is equal.

On the leaderboard's plot, each team is a dot, quality against cost or time; the dotted line is the Pareto front,
the teams no other eligible team beats on both.

Test runs on the public scenario `public-1` show the points for each part of the answer, never the expected
values. Scored runs show quality, eligibility, cost and time without a breakdown.

## Final run

When the hackathon ends, the organizers run every team's latest submission that passed review (organizers resolve outstanding reviewer flags before the final run starts; rejected ones don't count) once by default (or best of three if you opt in before the final run starts) on a private dataset that is similar, not the same. It has the same jobs (a tender portal, a supplier portal, an ERP and a webmail inbox), the same bid rules and the same answer format, but different software, with a different look, navigation and site names, other content and data, and the information split differently across them. Your agent has to handle it as it finds it, and each run's brief states the bid rules. It ranks in the same order as above. Build an agent that works the
answer out from the websites, not one tuned to the public scenario.

## Winners

We pick the winners on three things, roughly in this order:

1. Performance on the private dataset (the final run).
2. Performance on the public dataset (the leaderboard).
3. The elegance of the system.

It is the latest submission, not the best one: your best submission holds your place on the leaderboard; your
latest one that passed review goes into the final run. The final run's results stay with the organizers until they
publish them. Then the leaderboard shows the final results, tagged "Private dataset · final", with each team's
public-dataset result and its change in rank beside them, and the public-dataset board stays at `$API/challenges/rfq/leaderboard?dataset=public` (Markdown:
`leaderboard.md?dataset=public`; API: `GET /v1/challenges/rfq/leaderboard?dataset=public`).

## RFQ scoring

The brief states the calculation rules. Each position has four optional fields that earn independent points:
`base_unit_price` (the EUR scale price per piece before discount), `surcharge_per_unit` (material surcharge plus
ordinary and allocated setup cost per piece, before discount), `packaging_per_unit`, and `rebate_total` (the
project-bonus credit for the **entire position**). Leave a field blank if unanswered; enter zero for a known zero.
The same calculation rules and answer format apply to the public and private datasets. You can also explicitly
omit unfinished positions in the form; completed fields retain their credit. You must sign and submit to score.

| Part (a bid) | Points |
| --- | --- |
| Decision | 5 |
| Tender reference | 5 |
| Discount percent | 5 |
| Total net (to the cent, consistent with the positions) | 5 |
| Arithmetic (every position, and a total that is their sum) | 5 |
| Withdrawn Q&A quantity check (when present) | 5 |
| Dated metal-index check (when present) | 5 |
| Positions (split evenly): material 20 %, quantity 15 %, base price 15 %, surcharge 10 %, packaging 10 %, project bonus 10 %, unit price 10 %, lead time 10 % | 75 minus the checks above |


For a no_bid case: decision 75, tender reference 5, no positions 5, a total of 0 15. A wrong decision costs its
points but leaves the other fields their credit.

Money is compared to the cent. Positions are matched by their position number; extra or duplicate positions cost
one position's share each.

## Final private evaluation: one attempt or best of three

The final runs your latest passed submission on the private set. The default is one attempt.

"""Approximate the challenge's quality score field by field (dev only).

usage: python dev/eval/score.py <answer.json> [--oracle dev/oracle/public-1.json]
Implements the bid-case table from docs/01-challenge.md. The two "checks" are approximations: the withdrawn-Q&A check
is scored as "the position whose quantity the oracle marks as withdrawn-affected is right", the metal-index check as
"every position's surcharge_per_unit is right". Sandbox test runs remain the ground truth.
"""
import argparse, json
from decimal import Decimal as D
from pathlib import Path

FIELDS = {"material_number": .20, "quantity": .15, "base_unit_price": .15, "surcharge_per_unit": .10,
          "packaging_per_unit": .10, "rebate_total": .10, "unit_price": .10, "lead_time_weeks": .10}
WITHDRAWN_CHECK_POSITION = "01.05"   # public-1 only (dev); the private set has its own

def eq(a, b) -> bool:
    if a is None or b is None:
        return False
    if isinstance(b, (int, float)) and not isinstance(b, bool):
        return D(str(a)).quantize(D("0.01")) == D(str(b)).quantize(D("0.01"))
    return str(a).strip() == str(b).strip()

def score(ans: dict, ora: dict) -> tuple[float, list[str]]:
    lines, pts = [], 0.0
    def add(name, ok, w):
        nonlocal pts
        pts += w if ok else 0
        lines.append(f"{'OK ' if ok else 'XX '} {name:<34} {w if ok else 0:>6.2f} / {w:.2f}")
    add("decision", ans.get("decision") == ora["decision"], 5)
    add("tender_reference", ans.get("tender_reference") == ora["tender_reference"], 5)
    add("discount_percent", eq(ans.get("discount_percent"), ora["discount_percent"]), 5)
    add("total_net", eq(ans.get("total_net"), ora["total_net"]), 5)
    pos = {p["position"]: p for p in ans.get("positions", [])}
    arith = eq(sum(D(str(p["quantity"])) * D(str(p["unit_price"])) for p in ans.get("positions", [])),
               ans.get("total_net"))
    add("arithmetic (total = Σ q×price)", arith, 5)
    opos = {p["position"]: p for p in ora["positions"]}
    w_check = opos.get(WITHDRAWN_CHECK_POSITION)
    add("check: withdrawn Q&A quantity", bool(w_check) and eq(pos.get(WITHDRAWN_CHECK_POSITION, {}).get("quantity"),
                                                               w_check["quantity"]), 5)
    add("check: dated metal index", all(eq(pos.get(k, {}).get("surcharge_per_unit"), v["surcharge_per_unit"])
                                         for k, v in opos.items()), 5)
    share = (75 - 10) / len(opos)
    for k, o in opos.items():
        a = pos.get(k, {})
        for f, w in FIELDS.items():
            add(f"{k} {f}", eq(a.get(f), o.get(f)), share * w)
    ids = [p["position"] for p in ans.get("positions", [])]
    extra = [k for k in ids if k not in opos] + [k for k in set(ids) if ids.count(k) > 1]
    if extra:
        pts -= share * len(extra)
        lines.append(f"XX  extra/duplicate positions {extra}: -{share * len(extra):.2f}")
    return pts, lines

if __name__ == "__main__":
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("answer"); ap.add_argument("--oracle", default=str(Path(__file__).parents[1] / "oracle/public-1.json"))
    a = ap.parse_args()
    ans = json.loads(Path(a.answer).read_text()); ans = ans.get("answer", ans)
    total, lines = score(ans, json.loads(Path(a.oracle).read_text()))
    print("\n".join(lines)); print(f"\nQUALITY ≈ {total:.2f} / 100")

"""Fail if public-scenario values appear in the submitted package (agent/). Dev only.

Values come from dev/oracle/public-1.json plus a list of keys/identifiers seen on the public sites.
usage: python dev/check_no_leaks.py [package_dir=agent]
"""
import json, re, sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).parents[1]
pkg = ROOT / (sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "agent")
ora = json.loads((ROOT / "dev/oracle/public-1.json").read_text())
needles = {ora["tender_reference"]}
for p in ora["positions"]:
    needles.add(p["material_number"])
    for f in ("unit_price", "base_unit_price", "total_net"):
        if f in p:
            needles.add(f"{p[f]:.2f}")
needles.add(f"{ora['total_net']:.2f}")
# identifiers seen on public-1 (keys, revisions, groups, logins, company data from the brief are allowed at runtime only)
needles |= set(re.findall(r"\b(?:VP|TZ|K|RP|PB|MET|FX|ER|GR|R|LH-VG)-\d{3,4}\b",
                          (ROOT / "docs/03-site-recon.md").read_text() + (ROOT / "dev/oracle/compute_public1.py").read_text()))
needles |= {"238,098", "2.743,58", "30,851", "13.25", "517.25", "1.0873", "64431", "PRD-635338",
            "u_9c3cb06a5d21b197", "kyora.run", "Linden Hydraulik", "DE811234567", "Buchenstadt", "linden-hydraulik"}
hits = []
for f in pkg.rglob("*"):
    if ".venv" in f.parts or "__pycache__" in f.parts:
        continue
    if f.is_file() and f.suffix in {".py", ".md", ".json", ".toml", ".js", ".txt", ".yaml", ".yml"} and f.name != "uv.lock":
        text = f.read_text(errors="ignore")
        hits += [f"{f.relative_to(ROOT)}: {n}" for n in needles if n in text]
if hits:
    print("LEAKS FOUND (public-scenario values in the package):"); print("\n".join(sorted(hits))); sys.exit(1)
print(f"ok: no public-scenario values in {pkg.relative_to(ROOT)}/ ({len(needles)} needles)")
